evidence.clarity: H1 'Wake to thirty minutes of sunrise. One dial, no app.' plus lede 'Morrow is a bedside lamp. Turn the dial to the time you want to be up...' states what and how at 1440 and 390; action 'Reserve a Morrow' with '$20 deposit, refunded whenever you ask. Checkout isn't connected yet, so no card today.' directly under it.
evidence.fit: Every brief constraint is reflected in behaviour: no payment path exists, the reserve button (#reserve, then mailto) is preceded by 'Checkout isn't connected yet, so this opens an email to us... take nothing today'; ship timing stays 'planned for next autumn' with no date; CAD drawn and labelled 'Drawn from the current CAD, not photographed'; explicit 'no sleep-science claims on this page' aside. Product details not in the brief (weighted base, diffuser callouts) are minor.
evidence.distinctiveness: Hero artifact is a bespoke SVG bedroom whose wall, bed, nightstand and lamp shade recolour from night to morning via CSS custom properties driven by the dial; window deliberately stays night ('The light is all Morrow's'). Later sections (numbered steps, settled/still-changing lists, FAQ accordion) are a familiar structure.
evidence.proof: Operable sunrise in the first viewport at 1440 (dial, readout '-18 min', play button, range all above y=900). Each step of the range changes --light (e.g. Home -> rgb(58,54,48) 'Off', End -> rgb(255,241,214) 'Full brightness'); labelled 'Drawn, not measured: the colours here illustrate the thirty-minute rise.' At 390 the scene starts at y~610 and the controls are below the fold.
evidence.craft: Tokenised CSS (:root colour/space/type scale, clamp() type), no console/page errors, axe [] at 390 and 1440, smallest text 13px, no overflow at 320-1440. Defects: figure.sunrise keeps the UA default margin (computed '18px 40px'), so the artifact is inset 40px each side and only 276px wide at 390; the 'Skip to content' link is focusable but stays 1x1px with no :focus style, so the first Tab stop is invisible; font tokens name Lora/Carlito which are never loaded (falls back to Palatino/Calibri stacks); a few inline style='margin-top' values.
evidence.mobile: 390: header collapses to a 'Menu' button (44px), menu opens (aria-expanded=true, list display:flex), Escape closes it and returns focus to the button, tapping 'Price and deposit' closes it and scrolls #reserve to top. Hero CTA at y=437 in first screen; range is 44px tall, play button 54px. Tapping the range at 95% gave '-1 min', tapping the dial's left side gave '-25 min'. Weak points: the 40px figure margins narrow the artifact to 276px, and when the controls are in view the scene (207px tall) has scrolled above, so the feedback is not next to the thumb.
evidence.honesty: Labels sit where the examples are: 'Drawing of the prototype; not a photo.' in the scene caption, 'Drawn, not measured' under the controls, 'width: not final' on the line drawing. The final reserve button says before the click that it opens an email and charges nothing. No invented reviews, numbers, dates or certifications found. The reserve@morrow.example address is not in the brief but is a .example placeholder and is disclosed as an email before the click.
evidence.interaction: 1440, keyboard: range (#t) takes Home/End/PageDown/arrows, clamps at -30 and 0 (ArrowLeft at -30 stays -30), phase text announced via role=status. Mouse drag on the SVG dial maps angle to value (left -26, top -15, right -6) and returns focus to the range. Play -> 'Pause the sunrise' (3s later -24 min) -> 'Resume the sunrise' with note 'Paused at -24 min.' -> resumes; arrow key during play stops it; finish shows 'Play it again' / 'Full brightness. Turn the dial to go back.'; replay restarts from -30. FAQ details open by click and keyboard. Minor: dragging into the dial's bottom dead zone jumps straight to 0 min; skip-link focus invisible; the mobile menu does not close on outside tap.
evidence.copy: Specific and consistent: 'Ten o'clock on a Sunday or six on a Monday; it is one turn either way. That sentence is the manual.', phase strings ('Amber. The room has edges again.'), button text matches behaviour ('Play the thirty minutes', 'Runs the whole rise in fifteen seconds.'). Some repetition of 'no app, no screen' across sections.
evidence.first_screen: 1440x900: H1, lede, 'Reserve a Morrow' with the no-card disclosure, and the lit scene plus dial and play button all visible without scrolling. 390x844: H1, lede, CTA and disclosure visible; the scene only begins at y~610 and the controls are below the fold, so the believability device is only partly in view.

evidence.clarity: H1 'A lamp that wakes you the way a window does.' is a metaphor; what it is becomes clear in the lede ('Thirty minutes before you want to be up, Morrow starts to glow...') and 'No app. No screen. One dial.' At 390 the lede sits below the artifact at y~790, so the first screen has only the metaphor and the demo.
evidence.fit: Pay-later constraint is acknowledged ('Deposits aren't open yet... hold a place with your email today'), and the ship timing is a season. But the 'hold a place' list the page is built around does not exist: HOLD_ENDPOINT is '' and the address is only written to localStorage. The page also invents product and company facts not in the brief: Charlotte location, 'has woken one of us every morning since spring', an optional chime 'we're testing', press-and-hold behaviour, and an automatic refund if the batch slips 'by more than a season'.
evidence.distinctiveness: Night-to-paper page structure follows the sunrise: dark hero, dusk 'how' section, a 'What the thirty minutes look like' list where each row is a colour band of the ramp, then morning-paper sections. Custom SVG dial with a filling arc and a clock readout (6:30 -> 7:00).
evidence.proof: Demo autoplays 600ms after load at 1440 and 390 (t=3.1s: '6:34', 'A faint ember...', button 'Pause') and is operable in the first viewport at both widths; caption 'Drawn, not photographed...' sits directly under it. Before autoplay starts the scene is nearly black and reads as empty.
evidence.craft: No console/page errors, axe [] at 390 and 1440, no measured overflow. But body has overflow-x:hidden, which masks overflow: submitting a 500-character email made #confirm scrollWidth 4242 vs clientWidth 478 at 1440 and the address ran past the card edge and off the page (no overflow-wrap). Tokens exist for colours but the JS hard-codes a parallel palette (NIGHT hex values, KEY ramp) and the CSS has scattered literal colours (#D9D3C4, #5C2E36, #6A1E0E...). No skip link; footer sits inside <main> so there is no contentinfo landmark; wordmark links to '#'.
evidence.mobile: 390: nav stays as three inline text links, 25px tall (How it works 91x25, The plan 59x25, Reserve 52x25) and wraps to two lines at 320; 'Pause' button 38px tall. H1, scene and dial fit the first screen, but 'Reserve a place' is at y=1028, below the 844 fold (and at y=1164 at 768x1024). No horizontal scroll.
evidence.honesty: After entering x@y.co and pressing 'Hold my place', the page says 'Your place is held. We've noted x@y.co. You'll get one email when the $20 deposit opens' although nothing is sent anywhere (HOLD_ENDPOINT = ''; only localStorage.setItem). The copy before the click ('Leave your email and we'll hold your place in line') does not disclose that. Also unsupplied factual claims: 'It sits on a nightstand in Charlotte and has woken one of us every morning since spring', 'Planned for autumn 2027', automatic refunds if the batch slips. Labels on the drawing are good.
evidence.interaction: Dial is role=slider with aria-valuenow/valuetext, tabindex=0, focus ring visible; ArrowUp/Down, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End all work and clamp (Down at 0 stays 0, Up at 30 stays 30); drag works (left 5, top 15), wheel works (+1), play/pause toggles and restarts from 0 when at 30; keyboard on the dial stops autoplay but merely focusing it does not. Form: empty, 'not-an-email', 'a@b' all show 'That doesn't look like an email address...' with focus returned to the input (no aria-invalid/aria-describedby link); pasted '   x@y.co   ' is trimmed and accepted; reload restores the held state from localStorage; 'That's the wrong address' resets. The success state itself is fake (see honesty); long input overflows the card.
evidence.copy: Warm and concrete ('Full light, a warm white. Nothing rang.', 'No charge. No newsletter. Only notes about Morrow.'). The status at minute 0 reads 'Thirty minutes to go' while the ramp section labels the same moment '0 min'; some lines speak for the team's sleep experience ('This is the point where most of us give up on sleep').
evidence.first_screen: 1440x900: H1, lede, 'Reserve a place' (y=703), disclosure and the auto-playing demo all visible. 390x844: H1 and demo visible and playing, but the promise sentence and the primary action are below the fold.

problems: 'Hold my place' reports 'Your place is held. We've noted <email>' and promises future emails, but nothing is sent (HOLD_ENDPOINT is empty; the address only goes to localStorage) and this is not disclosed before submitting

Invented facts not supplied by the brief presented as true: prototype 'in Charlotte' that 'has woken one of us every morning since spring', a chime 'we're testing', 'autumn 2027', automatic refund if the batch slips a season
body overflow-x:hidden masks real overflow (long email runs off the confirmation card and page); 390 nav targets are 25px tall with no menu, and the primary action is below the fold at 390 and 768

hard_fail_flags.evidence: The primary action 'Reserve a place' leads to the 'Hold my place' form. Submitting a valid email shows 'Your place is held. We've noted x@y.co. You'll get one email when the $20 deposit opens, and another whenever the plan changes.' No request is made: in the inline script HOLD_ENDPOINT = '' so the fetch branch never runs, and the address is only stored in the visitor's own localStorage (key 'morrow.held'). Before submitting, the page says 'Leave your email and we'll hold your place in line' and 'you can hold a place with your email today', with no statement that nothing is sent.
hard_fail_flags.steps: Open packets/P002/B/index.html from disk at 1440x900 with devtools Network tab open. Click 'Reserve a place' (jumps to #reserve). Type x@y.co in 'Your email' and click 'Hold my place'. Observe the 'Your place is held. We've noted x@y.co...' panel and zero network requests; in the console, localStorage.getItem('morrow.held') returns 'x@y.co'. View source around 'var HOLD_ENDPOINT = '';'.

reason: Both demos are solid and both pages load clean with no errors or axe violations, but A's reserve path does exactly what it says before the click, while B's form confirms a held place and future emails for an address that is never sent anywhere, and B adds unsupplied facts about the prototype and refunds. A's defects (default figure margins narrowing the artifact on phones, an invisible skip link) are small CSS fixes; I would change my mind only if B's form were wired to a real collector or clearly said it stores nothing yet.
